title: Asymptotic midpoint renormability versus AUC
exact_target: Must every infinite-dimensional real Banach space that admits an asymptotically midpoint uniformly convex norm also admit an equivalent asymptotically uniformly convex norm? Positivity of the midpoint modulus is in the finite-codimensional averaged two-sided convention; AUC uses the corresponding one-sided convention.
